actions-list.actionItem: Pursuant to the order of yesterday, the Journal of the      proceedings of the Senate was deemed approved to date.
Pursuant to the order of yesterday,      the morning hour being deemed expired, and the times for the recognition      of the two leaders being reserved.
The following transactions of morning business occurred on today      .

H.R. 2347 (Rep. Smucker):
                A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to exclude from gross income any damages, other than punitive damages, received on account of any sexual acts or sexual contact.      

        --        Considered by Senate.      

        --        Motion to waive all applicable budgetary discipline with respect to H.R.        2347 agreed to in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 70 - 26. Record Vote Number:        266      


        --        Cloture on the measure invoked in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 65 - 31. Record        Vote Number:        268      

         

 S.Amdt. 6883 (Sen. Capito):
        In the nature of a substitute.

        --            Considered by Senate.          

        --            Point of order that the amendment violates section 4106 of H.Con.Res.71,            115th Congress raised in Senate with respect to amendment SA 6883.          

        --            Amendment SA 6883 agreed to in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 69 - 27. Record            Vote Number:          
        

 S.Amdt. 6884 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --            Considered by Senate.          

        --            Motion to table amendment SA 6884 agreed to in Senate by Voice Vote.          
        

 S.Amdt. 6885 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --            Considered by Senate.          

        --            SA 6885 fell when SA 6884 tabled.          
        

 S.Amdt. 6886 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --            Considered by Senate.          

        --            Motion to table amendment SA 6886 agreed to in Senate by Voice Vote.          
        

 S.Amdt. 6887 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --            Considered by Senate.          

        --            SA 6887 fell when SA 6886 tabled.          
      

    

 H.R. 2478 (Rep. Wagner):
                A bill to amend the Investment Company Act of 1940to postpone the date of payment or satisfaction upon redemption of certain securities in the case of the financial exploitation of specified adults, and for other purposes.      

        --        Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs discharged by        Unanimous Consent.      

        --        Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.      
    

 S. 4445 (Sen. Cortez Masto):
                A bill to amend title 18, United States Code, to enhance penalties for certain crimes committed against veterans, and for other purposes.      

        --        Senate Committee on the Judiciary discharged by Unanimous Consent.      

        --        Passed Senate without amendment by Voice Vote.
By unanimous consent, on the request of Mr. Husted, at      7:27 p.m., the Senate adjourned, under its order of today, until      10 a.m. tomorrow.
